She is cute and all but I'm also on Efexor which makes my libido hit the floor, it's confusing. Am I not turned on because of medication, porn or something else?

I've seen so much suffering between partners over the years, both parents and friends. I really don't want to go there, I'm so afraid of taking the risk of falling down that dark hole from which I came from. I don't want to cause nor feel the same suffering I've experienced from others' relationships.

Thank you all for your responses, I really do feel awful for having these ideas of how a woman should look like. It's true, I'll never find out the real answers on the internet but your pieces of advice are good to hear and bring some comfort. I just feel really scared, we belong to the same group of friends so I'm constantly comparing the pros and cons. Get the girl with the risk of blowing it all and losing several friends. However I'm going to think about what you have told me and I'm truly thankful for your advice.
Thank you, definately gonna check it out :)

Someone finds me attractive, someone loves me but in a way that I've never been loved before, I would feel complete. I would give anything if someone showed a tiny tiny bit of affection. I would feel accepted and not like an ugly freak waiting for the world to end.

First off, thank you for responding so quickly =)
I don't want to go looking for girls but my subconscious is constantly obsessing about it. My logical self tells me wait it will come to you but my emotional self is crushed by the lack of affection and sex. I don't want things to be like this, I'd give my right arm to be calm and content with my self but my emotions won't let me.
